tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: The base of every screen, under the ambient glow.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Fields, the track of a segmented switch and solid cards on the background.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Chips, quiet buttons and the empty track of a meter, one step above the surface.

tokens.name: color-surface-selected
tokens.usage: The picked option of a segmented switch and a switch that is off.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Titles, amounts and body text on the background, the surfaces and glass; the fill of a selected chip.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: chips, figures beside a name, the text of a notice.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Section labels, captions and the quiet notes of a row.

tokens.name: color-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Hints, placeholders and unselected options; the dashed border of an empty chip. Never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Emerald, for accents only: the main button, the selected tab, links, income and progress that is fine.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on color-accent, such as the main button.

tokens.name: color-accent-highlight
tokens.usage: The light line along the top edge of the main button.

tokens.name: color-accent-soft
tokens.usage: A tint of the accent behind a positive pill or a selected glyph.

tokens.name: color-ambient
tokens.usage: The glow in the corners of every screen.

tokens.name: color-positive
tokens.usage: Money in and changes for the better: income, a rise of the capital.

tokens.name: color-negative
tokens.usage: Money out over plan and changes for the worse: a fall, a limit that is over, deleting.

tokens.name: color-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules between rows and the border of segmented switches.

tokens.name: color-art-emerald
tokens.usage: The glow of the abstract art of an account card in this color.

tokens.name: color-art-rose

tokens.name: color-glass-fill-top
tokens.usage: The top of the gradient fill of glass.

tokens.name: color-glass-fill-bottom
tokens.usage: The bottom of the gradient fill of glass.

tokens.name: color-glass-border
tokens.usage: The hairline border of glass.

tokens.name: color-glass-highlight
tokens.usage: The light line along the top edge of glass.

tokens.name: color-nav-fill
tokens.usage: The fill of the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: color-nav-highlight
tokens.usage: The light top edge of the tab bar.

tokens.name: color-nav-lowlight
tokens.usage: The faint bottom edge of the tab bar.

tokens.name: color-nav-bubble
tokens.usage: The bubble under the selected tab.

tokens.name: color-nav-bubble-highlight
tokens.usage: The light top edge of the bubble.

tokens.name: color-nav-label
tokens.usage: The labels of tabs that are not selected.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: The capital on the overview: the largest amount. Tabular figures.

styles.name: text-hero
styles.usage: The amount of a transaction and the hero of a sheet.

styles.name: text-amount
styles.usage: Amounts on cards and in rows that lead. Tabular figures.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Running text and the values of rows.

styles.name: text-body-strong
styles.usage: Names in rows, the text of buttons and chips.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Notes under rows, figures beside a name, dates.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Short section labels in capitals, such as ACCOUNTS. Set in capitals.

styles.name: text-tab
styles.usage: The labels of the tab bar.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Inside pills and between a meter and its note.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label, and between rows of a group.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Between the parts of a card.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: The padding of glass and the side margin of a phone screen.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Between the text and the actions of a notice; button padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between the sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Above a page title and around large amounts.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small badges and tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Glyph badges of categories and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Options inside a segmented switch, fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass cards, panels and segmented switches.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Account cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, pills, switches and meters.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Under glass cards and panels.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: Under the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-nav-bubble
tokens.usage: Under the bubble of the selected tab.

tokens.name: shadow-accent-glow
tokens.usage: The emerald glow under the main button.

tokens.name: blur-control
tokens.usage: The backdrop blur of small glass controls.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: The backdrop blur of glass cards and panels.

tokens.name: blur-nav
tokens.usage: The backdrop blur of the tab bar.

tokens.name: saturation-glass
tokens.usage: How much glass boosts the colors behind it: 1.6 is 160 %.

tokens.name: saturation-nav
tokens.usage: How much the tab bar boosts the colors behind it.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Presses, switches and hovers.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Rows that open, chips that turn, most changes on screen.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Fades between states and colors that change.

tokens.name: duration-roll
tokens.usage: Digits that roll to a new figure, and the parts of a ring that move to their new shares.

tokens.name: duration-zoom
tokens.usage: A card that grows into its page, the longest way anything travels.

tokens.name: duration-spring
tokens.usage: The tab bar bubble and switches.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that moves, unless it springs or fades.

tokens.name: easing-spring
tokens.usage: Overshoots a little, like a spring.

tokens.name: easing-fade
tokens.usage: For opacity: starts and ends gently, so that a cross-fade does not snap.

tokens.name: size-touch-target
tokens.usage: The smallest tap area.

tokens.name: size-nav-bar
tokens.usage: The height of the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: size-scroll-edge
tokens.usage: How deep a list fades where it goes under a header or a button that stays in place.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: The height of the count on the corner of a button, such as the new notices on the bell.

tokens.name: font-weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body text and captions.

tokens.name: font-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Rarely: a quieter emphasis than semibold.

tokens.name: font-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Names in rows and strong body text.

tokens.name: font-weight-bold
tokens.usage: Section labels, tab labels and counts.

tokens.name: font-weight-extrabold
tokens.usage: Manrope titles and amounts.
